verdict.rationale: Teams hosts agents and Copilot Chat, so letting users plug in MCP servers as tool sources is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP client support or connecting external MCP servers. The bot, agent, webhook, Graph API and Agents Toolkit material describes other extension mechanisms, not MCP tool integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
